# Hebrew UI strings — exact replacements (written by a native speaker)

Apply these **verbatim** to the `he` object in `src/shared/i18n.ts` (same keys). Do not rephrase, shorten or "fix" them.
Keys not listed here stay as they are. Placeholders `{…}` must be kept exactly.

Style rules if you add any new Hebrew string: short, plain spoken Hebrew; buttons are a single verb/noun (e.g. "יצירה", "הורדה"); instructions use plural present ("מעלים", "בוחרים"); never translate word-for-word from English; product names (Spark, SAM, Muse Image, Meta, PNG, ZIP) stay in Latin letters.

Notes for the code (not translations):
- `card_proof` now reads "Product & logo: {count} px changed" — drop the `{what}` variable from this message in both languages (English: `Product & logo: {count} px changed`).
- `qa_retry` = shown when the automatic retry fixed the output; if the retry did not fix it, show only `qa_fail`.
- `brand_colors` example contains Latin codes inside Hebrew — keep the LRM mark (U+200E) before the first `#` so the order renders correctly.
